paragraphs.html: Taking public transit (CTA/Metra) or rideshare (Uber/Lyft) is recommended. There is no parking garage — we recommend using SpotHero.

paragraphs.html: Building entrance is on Wacker Drive, next to the corner of Wacker and Randolph.
Please check in with security at the front desk lobby with your government ID, 15 minutes prior to your interview.

cards.title: Photo ID
cards.body: Please bring a valid government ID.

cards.title: NDA
cards.body: Before your scheduled interview, please ensure that you electronically sign our NDA using Box Sign through the provided link.
cards.note: All candidates are required to sign in order to begin their interview. If you have any questions regarding the NDA form, please reach out to your Recruiting Coordinator.

cards.title: Arrival & departure
cards.body: Once you arrive to the 7th floor, please use the tablets available at the reception desk to register as a Box guest, choose the host name, sign the NDA (if you did not sign it prior to), and take your photo. The WPS specialist will print out your name tag.

contact.heading: Questions?
contact.body: Got a question we didn't cover? Reach out to your Recruiter and Recruiting Coordinator.
